title: Bridge Tolls
prompt:
**Problem.** Directed graph, tolls on arcs. Print the minimum total
toll from city 1 to city n.

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 100000; 0 <= m <= 200000; tolls <= 1e9;
n is always reachable.

Hop-counting BFS is the classic near-miss.

tests.name: tolls beat hops
tests.hint: Cheapest: 1->3 (2), 3->2 (1), 2->4 (3) = 6. Hop-counting BFS reaches n in 2 hops.

tests.name: unit weights agree
tests.hint: With every toll 1, hops and tolls coincide.

tests.name: load: 100000 nodes, 200000 weighted arcs
tests.hint: Dijkstra with a binary heap; BFS-on-weights misorders the frontier.
